claims: Venezuela defeated the USA 3-2 on March 17, 2026.
Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic title on March 17, 2026.
Eugenio Suárez hit a go-ahead RBI double in the top of the ninth inning to secure the win in the championship game.
Eugenio Suárez's 9th-inning double broke the 2-2 tie.
Maikel Garcia was named the MVP of the tournament.
Team USA had a second consecutive runner-up finish.
The final was held at loanDepot Park in Miami
